title: Consent & Compliance Log
user_visible_behavior: Sale/Counseller/Team Leader can log a consent event (opt-out, re-subscribe, marked test, bounced, suppressed) for a CRM Contact; the matching snapshot flag (is_opted_out/is_test_record/email_bounced) updates automatically and is filterable in the Contact list.
verification_command: bench migrate && bench console (create CRM Contact Consent Event records and inspect CRM Contact flags)
evidence: Verified on local dev bench (docker crm-dev, site crm.localhost): bench migrate ran clean. bench console test on real contact CRMC-2026-00001: is_opted_out 0->1 on Opted Out insert, stays 1 on duplicate Opted Out insert (idempotent), 1->0 on Re-subscribed insert. Hook fires correctly via doc_events after_insert.
notes: Email Unsubscribe investigation (step 6) complete: the core doctype exists in this Frappe version but has 0 records on crm.localhost dev site — no pre-existing opt-out data, so no backfill patch is needed before trusting is_opted_out for send-eligibility filtering. Re-check record count against production data before relying on this in production.

title: Contact Business Fields
user_visible_behavior: Contact form shows Next Follow-up (Datetime), Decision Maker (Student/Parent/Both), and Preferred Contact Channel (Email/Zalo/Phone); all optional, existing contacts unaffected.
verification_command: bench migrate (verify existing CRM Contact records load/save with new fields empty)
evidence: Verified on local dev bench (docker crm-dev, site crm.localhost): bench migrate ran clean, all 3 fields (next_follow_up, decision_maker, preferred_contact_channel) confirmed present as DocField records. Loaded and re-saved an existing contact (CRMC-2026-00001) via bench console: new fields default to None/empty, save succeeds with no errors.

title: AI Lead Insight for Contact
user_visible_behavior: New CRM AI Lead Insight doctype linked to CRM Contact holds AI-generated summary/interests/objections/risk-flags plus a human review workflow (status/reviewed_by/reviewed_at/review_note); Sale/Counseller/Team Leader can action status but cannot edit AI-generated content fields directly (permlevel 1, read-only for those roles).
verification_command: bench migrate && bench console (create insight, attempt field edits as Sale-role test user)
evidence: Verified on local dev bench: bench migrate clean. Created a Sale-role test user (sale-test@example.com) and confirmed via bench execute: (1) Sale user CAN save status/reviewed_by changes; (2) Sale user's attempted edit to summary is silently reverted by Frappe's permlevel enforcement on save (DB value confirmed unchanged after the Sale-user save call) -- field-level write restriction works as designed, just via silent-revert semantics rather than a raised PermissionError.
notes: source_ai_job is a loose Data field, confirmed empty by design (no AI integration in this plan).

title: AI Personal Email Draft
user_visible_behavior: New CRM AI Personal Email Draft doctype covers one contact's personal email through Generating -> Draft/Edited -> Approved -> Sent/Failed/Cancelled, with generated vs. edited subject/body kept separate, and a documented (not implemented) plug-in point for linking the eventual Communication record once frappe.sendmail is wired up.
verification_command: bench migrate && bench console (create draft, step through status values, link a Communication record and confirm it surfaces via crm.api.activities.get_activities)
evidence: Verified on local dev bench: bench migrate clean. bench execute test created a real draft against contact CRMC-2026-00001, stepped status Generating -> Draft -> Edited -> Approved -> Sent successfully, then created a Communication record, linked it via draft.communication + sent_at, and confirmed it appears in frappe's docinfo.communications list (the same data crm.api.activities feeds into the contact timeline) -- Phase 4 success criterion (sent draft visible in existing timeline/activity view) holds. No frappe.sendmail wiring (explicitly out of scope). Test data cleaned up after verification.
notes: Approval-before-send is a status value only, not server-enforced in this phase — flagged in plan Risks as follow-up work for when send logic is built.

title: Team & Membership Foundation
user_visible_behavior: Staff can belong to multiple CRM Teams (via CRM Team Membership on CRM Staff); 4 new roles (Marketing Operator, Marketing Lead, Admissions Operations, Admissions Director) exist; CRM Contact and CRM Student list views are now both scoped by one shared function per the locked BR matrix (own-assigned for Sale/CTV-Sale, own-team+unassigned-pool for Team Leader, team/campus for Counseller/Promoter-PR) — closing Counseller's prior system-wide Student exposure.
verification_command: bench migrate && bench execute crm.patches.v1_0.backfill_team_membership_from_staff.execute (idempotency check: rerun, assert no duplicate membership rows) && per-role before/after visible-record-count comparison for every active CRM Staff account
